station_name: Stevens Creek Reservoir near Monte Vista, Calif.
township_range_section: NW¼ sec.27, T.7 S., R.2 W.
notes: 13 month-end contents printed (Sept. 30 through the next Sept. 30), counted row by row. Title says water year October 1967 to September 1968; the first row (Sept. 30) is the end of the previous water year, so start is given as 1967-09-30 (years taken from the title, not printed in the rows); by the water-year rule it would be 1967-10 to 1968-09. Other location words: at center of dam on Stevens Creek, 2.0 miles southwest of Monte Vista. No meridian, no county printed. Dam completed in 1936 (not a well, construction_date left blank).
